question: How wide is the |omega| good-fit basin (i.e. how fine must the |omega| grid be), and would the s082 'densify N_mag 5->15' prescription cover the LS-bracket?
hypothesis: The |omega| basin is sharp enough that brute-force gridding is infeasible; |omega| must be refined in 1-D rather than treated as a joint-grid axis.
narrative_md: Measured the |omega| basin via 1-D sweeps with q+omega-dir held at truth. The basin is razor-thin: +-2% (slow 116) down to <+-0.5% (fast 119, SAM 103), so the s082 'densify N_mag 5->15' prescription is 10-100x too coarse — brute-force |omega| gridding is dead, |omega| must be refined in 1-D. Layer B (best Sobol-64 q + oracle |omega|) never reaches Band B, so q-coarseness is independently fatal. Band B edge is a constant ~9.6 deg of accumulated phase across seeds. Jacobi vs DOP853 agree to ~1e-6 deg. Holds q/omega-dir at truth -> oracle_clean false.
